thread:
maya: Starting deployment for repo/service: text-serve v4. Release notes: improved batching heuristics + optional int8 quant. Change window 22:00-23:30 UTC. Feature flag `textserve_v4` will be ramped with a pinned model-version strategy. Plan: canary 1% (10m) pinned to model=4.0, then 10% (20m) -> 40% (30m). If any perf regressions or errors, immediate hold and revert to model=3.9. @deploy-bot kick off canary when ready.

deploy-bot: Canary launched (run=canary-5256001234). Routing applied: textserve_v4=1%. Cohort pinned: model=4.0 for canary instances. CI artifact: https://ci.internal/artifacts/text-serve/v4/5256001234

liam: FYI last week we saw degraded tail latency with int8 on long sequences. Recommend setting `quant_mode=opt-in` so only controlled pods use int8.

maya: Good call. I updated canary config to `quant_mode=opt-in` and ensured only cohort nodes load int8.

jen: Adding automatic guard: hold if error_rate > 0.4% for 10m OR p99 > baseline_p99 + 80ms for 5m. Also enable a delayed auto-unpin window of 1h to prevent flipflop.

ops-bot: Monitoring hooks created: alert_group=textserve-canary-5256001234. SNS: #oncall-eng.

perf-bot: Canary metrics (t+8m): qps=1200, error_rate=0.05%, p99=260ms (baseline_p99=230ms). No holds triggered.

maya: Proceeding to step -> 10% at +10m. deploy-bot please execute ramp.

deploy-bot: Ramp step executed: textserve_v4=10%. Command: `/ff set textserve_v4 10 --by=deploy-bot --note="ramp-step-1"`

qa: Quick smoke: ran `curl` tests across edge regions. One failure in eu-west-2 with 502s. Investigating if it correlates to routing mesh.

perf-bot: Canary metrics (t+22m): error_rate=0.48%, p99=325ms. Alert: p99 > baseline + 80ms for 5m. Triggering hold.

maya: Hold detected. Initiating emergency hold and targeted rollback for the 10% cohort. Manual command I'll run: `/ff set textserve_v4 2 --note="hold-and-diff"` to reduce exposure while we triage.

deploy-bot: Applied: textserve_v4=2%. Note: partial rollback to reduce blast radius.

liam: Suggest we pin back to model=3.9 on all unstable pods: `/model pin text-serve model=3.9 selector=region:eu-*` — this will avoid mass config churn while we investigate int8 path.

jen: Also turning off int8 for the cohort: `/config set quant_mode=off --selector=cohort:canary-5256001234`

ops-bot: Alert escalated to oncall. Incident created: INC-5256001234. Pager assigned: liam.

qa: Re-run smoke (after hold): eu-west-2 passes now. No 502s in last 5m.

perf-bot: Post-mitigation metrics (t+36m): error_rate=0.08%, p99=240ms. System stable.

maya: Thanks. We'll keep the flag at 2% for now and block further ramps until ML infra confirms quant configs. We'll capture config diffs and include them in the postmortem.

liam: I'll collect kernel selection logs and quant traces. Planning a short internal run with longer sequences to reproduce.

jen: For future ramps, let's add a pre-ramp smoke that exercises long seqs and a synthetic p99 check.

maya: Good action items. I'll update release notes to indicate pinning and the emergency hold: https://releases.internal/text-serve/v4/5256001234/notes. Closing this thread for ops until triage complete :white_check_mark:
